result.reason: The clause substantively reaches the playbook position: the cap is mutual, aggregate, and equal to the greater of 12 months’ paid/payable fees and USD 1,000,000; the consequential-damages exclusion remains mutual; all specified carve-outs are uncapped; and Company’s fee-payment obligations are outside the cap. The revision is appropriately limited and preserves the existing damages exclusion. Minor drafting deviation: the fee lookback runs from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim itself, as stated in the preferred position, but the clause still comfortably satisfies the fallback and otherwise tracks the preferred position.
